subject: af-dy
title: AF.DY.------C.INFO.
description: Chart on book p. 206 (WAC-4). AF-DY (affinity dynamics) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; C-INFO (composite information) is the partner. From the subject: CULT-INFO-DY (culture information dynamics). From CULT-INFO-DY: INDIV-TD (individual tendencies), with the (C) prefix, "the concept of" and MT-INFO (multi-information). From MT-INFO: AFI (affinity insight), ALT-D (alternative definitions) and ACT-T (actual terms). ATTN (attraction), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of" is on a dotted line from MT-INFO. From ALT-D: AFL (affinity alignment).
